headline: Infineon authors report Analog UVM stimulus and automated behavioral-model comparison
fact: Two Infineon DVCon 2014 papers describe an Analog UVM library for constrained-random analog transactions and automated comparison of analog behaviors. The model-validation flow uses an earth mover's distance implementation connected through SystemVerilog and C to convert waveform comparison into regression pass/fail results, reducing reliance on manual waveform inspection.
